title: Funky Filipino-Style Roe Fried Rice
description: A spicy and savory twist on traditional fried rice, featuring fish roe and funky Filipino flavors.
instructions: Heat a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the funky Filipino sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spatula as it cooks.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the fish roe and cook for 1-2 minutes, until it starts to break apart.
Add the aerated rice to the wok or skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the boodle sauce and soy sauce to the rice and stir-fry for another minute.
Season the fried rice with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and garnish with additional fish roe if desired.
